summary: The trace confirms the existing edit-embedded-office-xml skill covers the core workflow well. The agent succeeded after two ZIP-handling failures: (1) in-place modification of the same PPTX file caused 'Truncated file header', and (2) a context-manager scope issue closed the source zip prematurely. The existing skill already warns against dict-based ZIP reconstruction and provides the correct ZipInfo-preserving pattern. I'm adding an explicit anti-pattern for in-place ZIP modification and tightening the repack guidance to prevent these specific failure modes.
